name: Pandaemoniac Inferno
legend: Once the daemons of Tzeentch are loose aboard a ship they spread like a kaleidoscopic firestorm. Their mad cackles meld with the screams of their victims as the daemons’ mutative touch twists both the infested voidship and the unfortunates who defend it, blending them amidst gruesome conflagrations of change.

rules.name: Living Flame
rules.legend: The daemons cavort and gibber amidst an inferno whose unholy flames are formed of their madness and cruelty made manifest. Such a blaze of contradictions cannot harm the daemons, for it is of them as they are of it, yet it burns all the hotter in their presence.
rules.description_html: Each lime a TzEENTCH LEGiONES DAEMONiCA unit from your army is selected to shoot, it can target enemy units within Engagement Range of other friendly TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA units. Ranged weapons equipped by TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA models have the [SUSTAiNED HiTS 1] ability while targeting a unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units.

stratagems.name: FATE SYPHONING
stratagems.legend: The daemons feed upon the raw potentiality that dances around strategically pivotal locations in order to sustain their corporeal manifestations.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One TzEENTcH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll saving throws of 1 made for models in your unit.

stratagems.name: ILLUSORY PRESENCE
stratagems.legend: Enemies can never truly be sure that where the y daemons of Tzeentch are is where they really are.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a TzEENTcH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That TZEENTCH unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: FICKLE BLESSINGS
stratagems.legend: Even the daemons of Tzeentch are not immune to the fundamentally unstable nature of their own magicks, which may twist and rupture their bodies as often as they lend terrible power.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HORRORS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities.

stratagems.name: INSUBSTANTIAL ENTITIES
stratagems.legend: Physical barriers are no obstacle to creatures that can will their desires into being with but a twist of their supernatural powers.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One TzEENTcH LEGIONES DAEMONIcA unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.

enhancements.name: Fulgurating Presence
enhancements.legend: Warplight dances and glares around this entity, flares of blinding brightness thrown off its warped form as though from the facets of a crooked crystal.

enhancements.name: Mutagenic Flames
enhancements.legend: The warpflame of Tzeentch is fuelled by sanity and soulstuff, and cannot be easily extinguished. Worse, it does not merely burn its victims, but instead distorts and mutates them in ever more hideous ways.
enhancements.description_html: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
